Explore IIT Certification Courses Advanced Certification in Data Science & AI Advanced Certification in Data Analytics Advanced Certification in Cloud Computing & Azure Programming Advanced Certification in Cloud Computing & DevOps Advanced Certification in Full Stack Development Advanced Certification in React JS & Angular Web Development Home > Vaidik Soni: From Aeronautical Engineer to Jr Data Scientist at Nagarro Vaidik Soni: From Aeronautical Engineer to Jr Data Scientist at Nagarro Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri July 8, 2026 11:47 am Introduction Vaidik Soni’s career transformation proves that with the right skills and guidance, switching to the IT industry is achievable. After completing a Bachelor’s Degree in Aeronautical Engineering and gaining two years of experience in the mechanical field, he decided to pursue a career in data science. His determination to learn in-demand technologies and build practical expertise helped him successfully transition into the IT industry. Today, Vaidik is working as a Jr. Data Scientist at Nagarro , a global digital engineering leader. Background Although Vaidik had a strong technical foundation through his engineering education, he realized that his career aspirations aligned more with data-driven technologies than the mechanical industry. After working for two years in the mechanical domain, he started exploring career opportunities with better growth, innovation, and learning potential. During his research, he identified that enrolling in a Data Science course in Pune could provide the practical skills and industry exposure required to make a successful career switch. Upskilling with 3RI Technologies Vaidik enrolled in the Data Science program at 3RI Technologies to build strong technical and analytical skills. The curriculum focused on Python, machine learning, data visualization, statistics, SQL, and real-world projects that reflected industry requirements. Continuous mentorship, hands-on assignments, mock interviews, and placement preparation helped him gain confidence in solving business problems using data. This practical learning approach prepared him to confidently face technical interviews and industry challenges. Transition to Company With consistent learning and dedicated placement support from 3RI Technologies, Vaidik successfully secured an opportunity with Nagarro . His practical project experience, problem-solving approach, and strong understanding of data science concepts impressed the interview panel. The transition from a mechanical professional to an IT role became possible through continuous upskilling, structured guidance, and focused interview preparation. His journey demonstrates that career transitions are achievable with the right training and commitment. Achievements as a Jr. Data Scientist As a Jr. Data Scientist at Nagarro , Vaidik contributes to developing data-driven solutions that support business decision-making. He applies machine learning techniques, data analysis, and visualization tools to solve real-world challenges while continuously expanding his technical expertise. His ability to adapt quickly to a new domain reflects his dedication to continuous learning and professional growth. Today, he is building a rewarding career in one of the fastest-growing technology fields after completing a Data Science course in Pune . Conclusion Vaidik Soni’s journey is an inspiring example of how professionals from non-IT backgrounds can successfully transition into the technology industry. By combining determination, practical learning, and expert mentorship from 3RI Technologies, he transformed his career and achieved his goal of becoming a Jr. Data Scientist at Nagarro . His success story encourages aspiring professionals to embrace upskilling and confidently pursue opportunities in the ever-growing field of data science.
